decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink mix builds on the firm's nutrient-from-biomass know-how, but it sits in a consumer market where its engineering-heavy knowledge base helps least in reading early results and improving the product, so it is the most exposed product though not yet clearly failing.

Modular waste-to-energy extensions draw directly on the firm's core engineering, automation and prototyping capabilities, so it can interpret customer feedback and refine the modules with its own R&D.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant has its own web page and fits squarely within the firm's established conversion technology, where in-house R&D and university cooperation give strong absorptive capacity for improving it.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is technically demanding, but it is close to the firm's waste-conversion expertise, and its research cooperations let it absorb the new knowledge needed to develop the plant further.
